name: lookdebug-mcp
description: Thin MCP wrapper for the in-app DebugBridge. Discovers simultaneous bridges on physical iOS devices only.

scripts.build: node --check src/config.js && node --check src/environmentPreflight.js && node --check src/runtimeTarget.js && node --check src/httpBridgeClient.js && node --check src/screenshotClient.js && node --check src/portForwarder.js && node --check src/server.js && node --check scripts/check-bridge-version-sync.js && npm run check:bridge-version:offline
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:bridge-version
